note: Union County, IN (FIPS 18161) publishes zoning only through a WTH GIS web viewer (unionin.wthgis.com) and a PDF unified zoning ordinance with a zoning map (joint county/Town of Liberty). No queryable ArcGIS REST service for zoning districts was found: the wthgis host returns 404 for /arcgis/rest/services, no zoning service appears in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for the county or Liberty, and the Liberty city hub has no zoning service located. Zoning is viewable, not downloadable.
